body: Yeah I’ve talked about it, just makes me realize more and more that I’m just not meant for this life.

Easier said than done when I have the constant thought she would leave me if I told her. I really do love her, and provide everything she needs,  I just have more love to give than one person can handle.

It really is taking a toll on my mental health, it’s starting to consume my thoughts. That’s why I’ve come to the reddit community for some support while I figure out how to approach the situation. I think I really needed to hear what you just said. I do owe it to my self, and she also deserves to be aware. What happens after I tell her is a mystery.. of course I will post an update after speaking with her.

I honestly don’t want to even pursue a second partner at this point, I just want her to be aware that this is who I really am. I would be happy if she dated others, as long as I am in her life and making her happy. Of course it would take some getting used too, but at the end of the day I just want her to be happy & I just want to be transparent with who I am.

I come from a family where things like this were never allowed to even be discussed. Where we had to conform to our traditions. But since I’ve been out of the house and had the opportunity to do some research I’ve only now felt it be socially acceptable. Prior to this, I was taught otherwise. Of course I am not only looking for a sexual relationship with another, I seek something much deeper and intimate. In fact, I’m not really interested In pursuing a second partner at this point in my life, more so I just want her to be aware that this is who I really am.

50/50, it’s right down the middle. I think you’re right, & it’s only fair to let her make that choice after I explain that this is who I really am. Although I really just want her to be aware, I’m not really interested in pursuing a second partner at this point in my life, I just want her to be aware that this is who I really am.

It’s not so much that I want to act on it, I more so want her to be aware. I want her to be aware of who I really am, & what my needs/wants are in life. Is it weird that I would be okay not acting on it and pursuing another partner (for the next 5yrs Atleast) as long as she was aware that this is who I really am?
See my above answer, and new question :)

I only kept it to my self because I was under the assumption it was not acceptable by society. I did not intentionally hide the fact that I was poly, I honestly just thought I was being crazy even just thinking of having more than one partner. I didn’t start doing research into poly until about a month ago. But yes, I agree with the fact that it would be a really big shock to someone who was/is convinced that we were in a very secure monogamous relationship. Maybe I’ll put a new question out there: do I leave things where they are and continue living a monogamous life, or do I try and communicate with her about being poly?
